rule: A deterministic algorithm may never depend on LLM code, nor on data a model produced about Fonoran. Deterministic output must be reproducible from seeds in git alone, which is impossible if any step reads a cache, aggregate, or ranking a model wrote.
_status: No file in this repository talks to a language model, and nothing reads model-written Fonoran. The last dependency was Learn, which compiled its phrase roman by replaying frames from the LLM translation cache; it now compiles from the deterministic translator, so lessons teach exactly what the language can say and the cache, client, and grammar brief are deleted. The checker stays in npm test to hold the line: quarantined and pending_cut must both stay empty.
_quarantined_comment: Files permitted to talk to a model. Nothing outside this list may import them. Adding an entry is a deliberate decision to reintroduce model code and needs a reason in the commit message.
_pending_cut_comment: Deterministic code that still reaches LLM code. Every entry is a bug with a known fix, never an accepted dependency. This must stay empty.
_model_authored_inputs_comment: English source text a model drafted, which the rule above deliberately permits. The distinction that matters: these files say what to translate, never what the answer is. A model that writes an English sentence makes no claim about Fonoran, so the same corpus through the same seeds still yields the same Fonoran by rule, and a human can read and edit the English. Model-written Fonoran is the thing that is banned, because it cannot be derived and so cannot be checked. Each file must be committed and pinned by hash in the fonora-data manifest so a corpus cannot change under a golden test.

model_authored_inputs.fonoran-stranger-corpus.json: The 1,000-phrase English corpus behind the golden translation tests and the Learn phrase lessons. Read by tools/fonoran-translation-gaps.js, tools/fonoran-course-phrases-build.js, and their tests. Pinned by sha256 in external/fonora-data/manifest.json.
model_authored_inputs.fonoran-compound-proposals.json: Human review queue from the deleted 2026-07 vocab survey. The rationale and gloss prose is model-written English and carries no authority; the composition suggestions are candidates only. Nothing enters the language until a human accepts a proposal and it lands in the seeds, so deterministic output never depends on this file. Mutable editorial state, not pinned.
